calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --worktree --task f1 --send 'do f1 and finish with the CLOSE block' --json
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --worktree --task f2 --send 'do f2 and finish with the CLOSE block' --json
mu agent spawn w3 -w eval --worktree --task f3 --send 'do f3 and finish with the CLOSE block' --json
mu agent wait w1 w2 w3 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 180
mu task close f1 -w eval --evidence 'f1 worker finished'
mu task close f2 -w eval --evidence 'f2 worker finished'
mu task close f3 -w eval --evidence 'f3 worker finished'
mu agent spawn v1 -w eval --task r1 --send 'review f1 (task r1) and finish with the CLOSE block' --json
mu agent spawn v2 -w eval --task r2 --send 'review f2 (task r2) and finish with the CLOSE block' --json
mu agent spawn v3 -w eval --task r3 --send 'review f3 (task r3) and finish with the CLOSE block' --json
mu agent wait v1 v2 v3 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 180
mu task close r1 -w eval --evidence 'r1 worker finished'
mu task close r2 -w eval --evidence 'r2 worker finished'
mu task close r3 -w eval --evidence 'r3 worker finished'
mu task close f2 -w eval --evidence 'reclosed after review'

git cherry-pick $(git -C $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w1 rev-parse HEAD) && git cherry-pick $(git -C $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w2 rev-parse HEAD) && git cherry-pick $(git -C $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w3 rev-parse HEAD)
mu task close umbrella -w eval --evidence 'fixes reviewed and merged, gate ok'

text: All three fixes are reviewed and merged; gate passes on main.
